name: devtools_genui
description: Shows Flutter DevTools GenUI (custom, interactive debugging UI built by the agent from live DevTools data) in the side pane, and tells the agent when you interact with it. Includes the skill for driving DevTools GenUI through the Dart MCP server.
suggestedPrompts: Build me a dashboard of my app's memory usage
Show the widget tree next to the layout explorer
Which functions are using the most CPU right now?
